correctStatements.text: At 07:05 wanjiru.k relayed that Kenyan users were seeing blank product photos in the Android app.
Tomasz-Wozniak found the CDN returning 404 for every /img/v3/ path since the 07:00 purge.
al-rashid admitted the purge pattern was too broad and matched origin keys as well.
wanjiru.k said support had received 140 tickets in 20 minutes.
At 07:21 Tomasz-Wozniak noted that origin bucket versioning was on, so the deleted keys could be restored.
At 07:27 al-rashid started the restore job for images deleted after 06:59.
At 07:34 nairobi-mobile-release-captain-handle-long held the 4.12 app release until images loaded again.
At 07:43 al-rashid reported the restore was 60% done with about 11 GB copied.
At 07:51 Tomasz-Wozniak saw the restore finish and the CDN edges refilling.
At 07:57 wanjiru.k confirmed photos were back for the Nairobi and Mombasa testers.
nairobi-mobile-release-captain-handle-long put the time with broken images at around 55 minutes.
Action item: dry-run every purge pattern against a listing first, owner al-rashid.
Action item: separate the CDN and origin key prefixes, owner Tomasz-Wozniak.
